items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I played all around with T-Boy and me. ... T-Boy was playing trumpet. ... When T-Boy had the band... this record band had them three trumpets, Poissy, T-Boy, and Tillman.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, you still have your E flat. Did you ever play many parades in the old days? Well I played. I'm a member of the Ricker band.
I got T-Boy with me. I was a member of the Ricker band. Oh yes.
Yeah I used to play this. I remember when T-Boy was the manager. T-Boy.
